title: Inventory: Albert et al. 2014 (Nature 506:494) supplementary files
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/albert2014/raw/`: every 'Supplementary information' item
listed on https://www.nature.com/articles/nature12904, downloaded untouched from static-content.springer.com
(Nature's PowerPoint copies of Figures 1-3 are not supplementary data and were not downloaded). The article page
is kept as `sources/albert2014/article.html`; the main text and Methods are paywalled, so only the abstract,
figure and Extended Data legends and the supplementary files are available. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.
Transcriptions of the PDF's Supplementary Tables 1-3, quoted facts and the member list of Supplementary Data 3

roles.41586_2014_BFnature12904_MOESM48_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Information: Supplementary Notes 1-2 (reproducibility; small effects and eQTL detection) and Supplementary Tables 1-3 (reproducibility statistics; local X-pQTL results for 41 genes; proteins affected by the chromosome II hotspot).
roles.41586_2014_BFnature12904_MOESM49_ESM.xls: Supplementary Data 1: full details of the 174 genes studied (coordinates, published GFP abundance, local eQTL/pQTL LOD and trans eQTL/pQTL counts from earlier studies, local experiment status, exclusion reason).
roles.41586_2014_BFnature12904_MOESM50_ESM.xls: Supplementary Data 2: the X-pQTL identified in this study (multiPeaksTable: gene, chromosome, peak, LOD, 2-LOD interval, allele frequency difference).
roles.41586_2014_BFnature12904_MOESM51_ESM.zip: Supplementary Data 3: allele count data used in the analyses (three text files, ~111 MB unpacked); listed in extracted/sd3_members.tsv, not unpacked into the repository.

missing: No table of the X-pQTL hotspots: Extended Data Table 2 ('Hotspot regulators of protein expression') is on the paywalled article page only, so no hotspot rows or causative genes are ingested.
No local/distant flag on the X-pQTL; the atlas defines local as a 2-LOD interval overlapping the tagged gene (OPEN_QUESTIONS).
No segregant counts for the sorted pools; FACS gates sampled thousands of cells per tail.
No statement of the genome build; positions are consistent with R64 (see OPEN_QUESTIONS).
